note: Fail-closed per-gate cardinality contracts for priv/ggen/ash-pplan-standing-pack.
Keyed by GATE STEM (gates/NNN_stem.rq -> "stem"), not filename.
Every contract is PREDICATE-anchored: the anchor's own blind spot (total loss of the
anchor predicate) is exactly what the companion verify/*.unbound.rq queries name, so
contract + companion have disjoint blind spots.
"chain" is a LIMIT 1 gate: expected 1 row whenever a single sg:ChainPolicy exists.
Anchored on sg:algorithmName (subject count = number of ChainPolicy individuals).
"canon" emits one row per sg:canonField edge (each field carries exactly one
fieldName/fieldOrder), so it is a VALUES contract on the edge predicate, not ROWS.
"fields" is likewise VALUES on sg:requiredKey: a ReceiptField may carry SEVERAL
required keys and the gate emits one row per (field, key) pair -- measured 12 gate
Fail-closed refusal gates in verify/ (ZERO rows on the clean graph = pass;
>= 1 row names the violating subject). Pattern ported from
queries return rows ONLY when an invariant is violated, wired fail-closed.
Anti-vacuity fixtures: fixtures/clean.ttl (0 rows required) and
fixtures/violating.ttl (>= 1 row required per gate), both merged over

150_untyped_refusal.invariant: an sg:ChainEntry with sg:entryStanding in {REFUSED, BLOCKED, UNSUPPORTED, COMPENSATION_FAILED} must carry sg:brokenTerm

160_standing_state_dangling.invariant: stl:StandingClaim.stl:hasStanding must point at an individual typed stl:StandingState (closes the 080 rung-join blind spot for untyped standing values)

170_standing_only_on_outcome.invariant: an sg:ChainEntry in phase 'pending' may carry only the neutral standing 'UNKNOWN'

180_outcome_requires_pending.invariant: every non-seal sg:ChainEntry in phase 'outcome' must name, via sg:pendingRef, the sg:entryId of a pending-phase entry of the same chain
